facts.claim: The writer was welcomed back after returning from England.
facts.quote: The writer having just returned from England was kindly welcomed back.

facts.claim: The ritual and discipline tend to become lax and attendance is very uncertain.
facts.quote: The ritual and discipline is apt to get lax, and the attendance is very uncertain.

facts.claim: Lodge Hyderabad still exists but is in an anemic condition with few signs of vitality.
facts.quote: Lodge Hyderabad still exists, but in a somewhat anaemic condition and shows but few signs of vitality.
